answer:
**Illustrative interview answer:** “I compared candidate models on a quality–latency–cost frontier at representative traffic. The larger model improved ranking quality but increased p99 latency and GPU cost. We measured how latency affected completed actions with a controlled experiment, then combined that estimate with incremental quality value.” [1](https://scikit-learn.org/stable/modules/model_evaluation.html) [2](https://sre.google/sre-book/table-of-contents/)

$$\Delta value\approx Q(\Delta value_{quality}-\Delta value_{latency})-\Delta serving\ cost.$$

“Ten milliseconds has no universal monetary value; it depends on user behavior and where the request sits in the end-to-end budget. We selected the highest-value feasible model under guardrails, keeping a fast fallback.” Substitute real estimates, uncertainty, and tradeoff ownership. AUC/NDCG deltas cannot be converted directly into revenue without a justified link to outcomes.
